desc: Building on Colt's Snake Gun legacy, the legendary double-action revolver returns in stainless steel with a bead blast finish available in 3", 4.25", and 6" barrel lengths! The Python features modern stainless steel alloys and a re-designed rear sight. Thirty percent more steel beneath the rear adjustable target sight gives you a stronger revolver and more robust shooting experience. A recessed target crown, user-interchangeable front sight, and Hogue rubber grip with the iconic Colt logo make this a gun you'll want to shoot and show off. The Python is chambered in .357 Magnum and also accommodates .38 Special cartridges.
